What Mom whispered, every night. 🌙 The same words, from his first day of school to the night before he left.

At five, Luke couldn't sleep before his first day. Mom came in and whispered. 🎒 At nine, after a hard day, she whispered again, and reminded him that tomorrow's worries weren't his to carry. At thirteen, Mom plugged in the night light and whispered them anyway.

At seventeen: "I'm so proud of you…" His eyes were still closed. 3,569 nights. Not once too tired. ❤️

Then Luke moved to the city, and Mom couldn't go with him. 🏙️ But every night, a text: "How is the new place?" 📱 And on the hardest night, he remembered her words, because they were never just Mom's:

"Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself." Matthew 6:34 (ESV) 🙏 Jesus walked into the hardest tomorrow for us.

In one study of 176 children aged 4-12, most of the kids had night-time fears, and most of their parents had no idea (Muris et al., 2001). 💔 So keep coming in. Keep whispering. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
